expected_behavior: Verification runs the tested command on its own, without chaining or piping, captures full output to a file, reports the tested process's own exit status, and quotes the summary line as the evidence.
observation: A completion claim was drawn from a command whose exit status was not the tested process's own status. When two commands are chained on success, an earlier failure can be masked; when a run is piped into another program, the reported status belongs to the last stage of the pipeline rather than the test process. Block buffering of standard output when piped also reordered the summary line out of the captured excerpt, so the visible evidence looked unrelated instead of absent.
